text: Keep technical decisions tied to approved versions.

A baseline identifies the technical configuration that has been accepted at a particular point. A typical life-cycle diagram distinguishes functional, allocated and product-level definitions as detail increases. Project managers coordinate resources, schedule and commitments. Engineering managers coordinate requirements, designs, technical proof and support. The two activities must exchange decisions and risk information.

items: Illustration: A test on configuration A cannot automatically demonstrate that a different installed configuration B meets the same requirement.

text: Record which configuration, evidence, responsibility and approval a technical conclusion relies on.
A plan without version control cannot establish which design was checked.
